container.heading: Licensure and Registration Examination — Applicants Requiring Accommodations

section.heading: Scope.
section.text: This chapter establishes the procedures to be followed by jurisprudence examination applicants who require accommodations because of a disability or religious convictions.

para.text: An applicant with a disability may request modifications in examination materials or procedures by making a written request to the Board that includes:
The date of the examination to be modified;
A letter from the appropriate medical professional that:
Provides information describing the accommodations required; and
A letter from the applicant’s education program, indicating what modifications, if any, were granted by the program.
The applicant shall send the request for modification and supporting documentation to the Board with the application.
The Board reserves the right to review each accommodation application and evaluate each on its individual merit.
The applicant may be required to bear the cost of special arrangements or procedures to accommodate the applicant’s individual needs.
